read.thesis: AIA's H1 2026 VONB rose 10% to US$3,212m (14% ex-Thailand) with OPAT per share up 13%, while the capital-cycle lens has little to say: this is a life insurer with no capacity or pricing supply signals.

triggers.label: OPAT/share CAGR target now exceeded
triggers.quote: AIA now expects to exceed OPAT per share CAGR target of 9 to 11 per cent from 2023 to 2026

triggers.label: Partnership VONB +18%
triggers.quote: VONB from partnership distribution increased by 18 per cent in the first half

triggers.label: China VONB margin 58.6% → 54.1%
triggers.quote: a 4.5 pps reduction in VONB margin to 54.1 per cent, reflecting a shift towards more capital-efficient participating savings products

guidance.quote: we now expect to exceed our 9 to 11 per cent OPAT per share CAGR target for 2023 to 2026

red_flags.label: Thailand VONB -6% and margin 115.7% → 96.9%
red_flags.quote: AIA Thailand delivered VONB of US$514 million, a fall of 6 per cent against an exceptional prior-year comparison

red_flags.label: Shareholder capital ratio 221% → 210%
red_flags.quote: The reduction largely reflected payments to shareholders of US$3,649 million
